description: This source file implements functionalities related to SSL private key management, including creation, loading, freeing, and setting private keys within SSL and SSL_CTX structures. It provides API functions such as EVP_PKEY_new, EVP_PKEY_free, d2i_PrivateKey, and SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey, among others.

methods.name: EVP_PKEY * __EVP_PKEY_new(EVP_PKEY * ipk,void * rngctx)
methods.description: Creates a new EVP_PKEY object, optionally cloning the method from an existing key.

methods.name: EVP_PKEY * EVP_PKEY_new(void * rngctx)
methods.description: Public wrapper to create a new EVP_PKEY, internally calls __EVP_PKEY_new.

methods.name: void EVP_PKEY_free(EVP_PKEY * pkey)
methods.description: Frees an EVP_PKEY object, after calling the associated method free routine.

methods.name: EVP_PKEY * d2i_PrivateKey(int type,EVP_PKEY ** a,const unsigned char ** pp,long length,void * rngctx)
methods.description: Loads a private key from DER-encoded data into an EVP_PKEY structure, optionally reusing an existing key.

methods.name: int SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey(SSL_CTX * ctx,EVP_PKEY * pkey)
methods.description: Associates the given EVP_PKEY as the private key for the SSL context.

methods.name: int SSL_use_PrivateKey(SSL * ssl,EVP_PKEY * pkey)
methods.description: Associates the given EVP_PKEY as the private key for the SSL structure.

methods.name: int SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_ASN1(int type,SSL_CTX * ctx,const unsigned char * d,long len)
methods.description: Loads a private key in ASN.1 DER format into the SSL context.

methods.name: int SSL_use_PrivateKey_ASN1(int type,SSL * ssl,const unsigned char * d,long len)
methods.description: Loads a private key in ASN.1 DER format into the SSL structure.

methods.name: int SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file(SSL_CTX * ctx,const char * file,int type)
methods.description: Intended to load private key from a file into SSL context (not implemented).

methods.name: int SSL_use_PrivateKey_file(SSL_CTX * ctx,const char * file,int type)
methods.description: Intended to load private key from a file into SSL structure (not implemented).

methods.name: int SSL_CTX_use_RSAPrivateKey_ASN1(SSL_CTX * ctx,const unsigned char * d,long len)
methods.description: Loads an RSA ASN.1 private key into SSL context by calling SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_ASN1.
